note: Back Bay, the North Landing River and the Northwest River drain south to Currituck Sound: their levels follow the wind, not the ocean tide, the Great Bridge lock keeps the Elizabeth River's tide out, and no StormSense gauge stands for them. Left out until one does.
The Blackwater River (western Isle of Wight and Suffolk) runs south to the Chowan River and Albemarle Sound: no ocean tide reaches it and no StormSense gauge stands for it. Left out until one does.
The Nottoway River runs south to the Chowan River and Albemarle Sound, like the Blackwater. Left out.
The Atlantic side of the Eastern Shore (Chincoteague Bay and the seaside lagoons): the nearest of the seaside gauges, never a Chesapeake Bay gauge across the peninsula.
The Chesapeake Bay side of the Eastern Shore, Tangier and Pocomoke Sounds: the nearest of the bayside gauges, never Wachapreague or Chincoteague across the peninsula.
The lower Potomac: the nearest Potomac gauge, never the Rappahannock at Tappahannock across the Northern Neck.
The tidal Rappahannock: the nearest Rappahannock gauge, never Dahlgren (Potomac) or West Point (York) across the necks.
The Mattaponi joins the York at West Point: its only gauge downstream, not the Rappahannock at Tappahannock.
The Pamunkey: its own gauge or West Point.
Dragon Swamp drains to the Piankatank, not to the York or the Rappahannock.
The Piankatank and Milford Haven: the Piankatank gauge or Windmill Point, not West Point or the Ware River.
The Northern Neck's bay shore (Little Wicomico to Fleets Bay): Lewisetta or Windmill Point on its own shore, not Tangier Island across the bay.

The Chickahominy (Henrico and Hanover down to the James at Barretts Point): Jamestown, at its mouth, never the Pamunkey at Lay Landing or Richmond Locks across the divide (its own gauge at Mamanahunt has no trusted readings yet).

The James from the falls at Richmond to Hopewell (Almond, Falling, Proctors, Fourmile, Turkey Island and Curles Creeks): Richmond Locks or Jordan Point, never the Appomattox gauge at Petersburg across the neck.
The James from Hopewell down to Flowerdew Hundred (Bailey, Powell, Herring and Queens Creeks): Jordan Point or Jamestown, never the Appomattox gauge at Petersburg.
The Appomattox: Pocahontas (Petersburg) or Jordan Point where it meets the James at Hopewell, not Richmond Locks.

The lower Appomattox (Ashton Creek to City Point): Jordan Point on the James at its mouth. Pocahontas, at the falls 15 km upriver, stands about a foot higher than the James (a week in Nov 2026: mean 1.58 ft NAVD88 against 0.50 at Jordan Point).
The tidal Potomac from Occoquan Bay to Little Falls with the Anacostia and Four Mile Run: the nearest of its own gauges.
